# Nova Mir

> Web development for small businesses. Custom websites, lead systems, and operational tools.

Nova Mir builds websites and digital tools that help small businesses get found, capture leads, and run smoother. Based in Oregon, USA. All prices in USD.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.novamir.dev/): Overview of services and approach
- [Services](https://www.novamir.dev/services): Managed Website ($1,500+), Website + Lead System ($3,000+), Website + Operations System ($5,000+)
- [Pricing](https://www.novamir.dev/pricing): Standard pricing and founding client program (3 slots at $1,500 flat)
- [Portfolio](https://www.novamir.dev/portfolio): Past work
- [Process](https://www.novamir.dev/process): How projects work — Discovery, Build, Launch
- [About](https://www.novamir.dev/about): Founder story
- [Contact](https://www.novamir.dev/contact): Get in touch
